_doc: xfs-win-driver matrix. XFS is read-only natively, so coverage focuses on host-side info/ls/cat probes plus vm-side mount + readback. RW (overlay-sidecar) scenarios are deferred — they need a sidecar emit + replay op shape not present in the shared scripts/win/. Test images are built by fixtures/build-test-disks.sh into ../rust-fs-xfs/test-disks/. Hashes captured against the canonical xfs-basic.img produced by mkfs_xfs over a synthesised source tree.

basic-info-volume._notes: Volume-level smoke. Asserts block_size + volume_name substrings so superblock decoding regressions trip a verdict. Capture: ./target/release/xfs info ../rust-fs-xfs/test-disks/xfs-basic.img

basic-ro-list-root._notes: Root-dir listing. Validates dirent decoding + name-set against the canonical xfs-basic.img source tree (test.txt, subdir/).

basic-ro-list-subdir._notes: Subdirectory listing. Validates non-root dirent traversal.

basic-ro-cat-test-txt._notes: Read content matches sha256 on /test.txt. Capture: printf 'hello from xfs\n' | shasum -a 256 -> 68f426e9...

basic-ro-cat-nested._notes: Read content matches sha256 on /subdir/nested.txt. Catches subdir-file extent decoding.

win-mount-ls-root._notes: End-to-end vm-side mount + listing via WinFsp drive letter. Self-contained mount-do-unmount per win-ls-via-mount step (cross-step persistent mounts don't survive single-SSH-per-step dispatch).

win-mount-cat-test-txt._notes: End-to-end vm-side mount + read of /test.txt via WinFsp drive letter. Validates the full WinFsp -> rust-fs-xfs read path on Windows.

overlay-sidecar-marker._notes: Placeholder for overlay-sidecar (--scratch-sidecar) coverage. The driver's RW path is in-memory overlay only; on dismount with --scratch-sidecar=PATH it serialises overlay state to JSON. The shared scripts/win/ ops don't have a sidecar emit + replay op shape, and per inst 2's review that shape is consumer-specific (not upstream-worthy). Unblock requires writing xfs-specific powershell op-defs in this repo's scripts/win/xfs-sidecar-*.ps1 plus matching [ops.xfs-sidecar-*] entries in harness.toml. Defer until the user signals interest in RW coverage.
